SPD_normalization: D0=diag(A0)^(-1/2), fixed per geometry; lambda_min(D0 (A0+H) D0)
gradient_check: all15 normalized objective derivatives at zero; abs(FD-analytic)<=1e-5*(1+abs(analytic)); abort before multistart if any fails
fixed_scales: Frozen KERNEL defaults; all other amplitudes zero
loss: mean of chi MSE, mu nested MSE, E2 MSE, W9E3 MSE, donorhalfstep-slope MSE
mu_loss: equal average of pairxyz MSE, four W9mu3xyz MSE, La donor fullxyz MSE; N is scalar row count
initialization: one H SLSQP then one bounded-linear h and one bounded-linear V for feasible H endpoint
joint_refinement: one all15 SLSQP from completed feasible conditional initializer
selection: best exact-box/all64-SPD conditional or final joint endpoint per start; lower full score, conditional on exact tie; across starts lower full score then earlier index
raw_solver_status: preserved; feasible unsuccessful endpoints may be retained without convergence claim
singular_off_domain_trial: loss1e30/zero derivative; no inverse padding, no candidate admission; count retained
minimum_eigenvalue_derivative: one eigenvector gradient; degeneracies are nonsmooth, not a unique derivative
ablations: baseline and same selected V with h=H=0; no additional fitting
scope: Finite nonconvex constructive test, not proof of global inadequacy or transferability
dispatch: Actual metal atomicnumber57/66 selects separate water V amplitudes; shared h/H and acetate V unchanged.
